title: ci(gates): the last two ratchet ledgers become one-sided — a decrease passes and is reported
body:
Refs #26586 (items 1, 3)

Items 2 and 4 stay on the card: item 2 is a comment in the governed `.github/workflows/lint.yml` (Tier H), and item 4 asks the maintainer for a ruling, so neither is touched here.

## What changes

The two ratchet ledgers that #26549 left two-sided become one-sided, the same treatment the other ten got: a decrease passes and is reported, an increase reds, and a baselined entry whose file is still on disk that the run never read is refused, so a dead scan stays red.

| Reader | Baseline | Decrease (now passes, printed on stdout) | Dead scan stays red | Self-test |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `check-engine-double-contract.mjs` | `engine-double-contract.baseline.json` (120 DEBT + 3 EXEMPT rows) | `reconcileDebtLedger().down` — a fallen count, a file with nothing unguarded left, an entry whose double is gone | new `UNREAD [verb]` error: a ledgered file still on disk that the discovery walk never read | new battery (11), roster floor 33 → 34 |
| `check-startup-registry-verdict.mjs` | `startup-registry-verdict.baseline.json` (empty today) | `reconcileLedger().stale` — printed with `↓`, exit 0 | new refusal: a ledgered key whose file is still on disk and was not in the corpus the walk read | new battery (8), roster floor 18 → 19 |

Both comparisons move into pure functions (`reconcileDebtLedger`, `reconcileLedger` / `unreadBaselined`) so the self-test drives both directions with no tree at all. Neither gate has a `--fix`/`--update`, so each decrease line names the hand edit that records it and the ceiling it leaves until then.

Kept as errors on purpose: a NEW unguarded engine double, a grown per-file count (`PINNED`), a finding with no ledger row, `DECLARED`, `DISCOVERED` / `SEAMS_DISCOVERED`, `RETAINED` / `SEAMS_RETAINED` (those two ledgers record COVERAGE and may only grow — the opposite polarity, untouched here), the population floors, and the dead-root refusals.

Item 3: the comment at `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.metadata-store-outage.test.ts:636-639` said the durability ledger and the code are "pinned to each other in both directions". Since #26549 only the restored-limb direction reds; a stale entry left behind after the fix passes and is reported. Comment-only, no assertion changed.

Header and `$comment` prose that described the old behaviour is rewritten rather than left behind: the `RECONCILED` invariant in `check-engine-double-contract.mjs` (with a new `UNREAD` row beside it), the RETAINED block's "ratchet the LEDGERED population in both directions" paragraph, which is now dated to #9680 rather than stated as current, one aside at L647, and both baselines' `$comment` blocks. No counts or keys moved in either baseline.

## Why

A stale entry reds a PR that never touched the gate: delete a listed test file, or fix the site a row licenses, and CI goes red with a remedy that belongs to a different card. #26444's Wanted 3, measured below on this card's own two ledgers.

## Verification

### Premise, measured on the base tree `fe53769a` before the change

Both gates exited 0 on that tree, and each redded on a legitimate decrease:

| Gate | Mutation on the base tree | Exit |
|:---|:---|:---|
| engine-double-contract | deleted `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-email-appname-precedence.test.ts`, a file the ledger lists for both `delete` and `update` | **1** — `RECONCILED [delete]: baseline entry for … declares no engine double with a delete any more` plus the `update` twin |
| startup-registry-verdict | the ledger is empty, so a stale entry was injected (`packages/core/src/gone-plugin.ts::GonePlugin.init()::cache`) | **1** — `1 stale baseline entr(ies) … the site no longer violates, so delete the entry` |

Each mutation was restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and `git status --porcelain` read clean afterwards.

### Acceptance, on head `36c37411`

| Gate | DOWN: a legitimate decrease | UP: a new violation |
|:---|:---|:---|
| engine-double-contract | the same file deleted → **0**, `DEBT ledger: 2 (file, verb) entr(ies) fell (passing, reported)` | the same file copied to a new path → **1**, `PINNED [delete]`/`PINNED [update]` on the copy |
| startup-registry-verdict | an injected row for a gone file → **0**, `↓ 1 stale baseline entr(ies)`; and an injected row for a file the walk DOES read (`packages/core/src/kernel.ts`) → **0**, reported the same way | a new `init()` probe that warns on the absent `cache` service, written into `packages/core/src` → **1**, `1 startup registry read(s) record a verdict the boot can still contradict` |

### Dead scans stay red

Each mutation landed through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit; write and restore verified on disk), and each restore printed `blob == HEAD` with an empty `git diff HEAD`:

| Gate | Mutation (the gate's own walk, one run) | Exit |
|:---|:---|:---|
| engine-double-contract | the discovery walk skips any directory named `commands` | **1**, four `UNREAD` findings naming the two ledgered files under `packages/cli/src/commands` for both verbs |
| startup-registry-verdict | `collectSourceFiles` skips `core`, with a row injected for a file under `packages/core/src` | **1**, `1 baselined entr(ies) … name a file still on disk that the scan never read` |

The population refusals both gates already had are untouched: `DISCOVERED`/`SEAMS_DISCOVERED`, the four population floors reached by every scanning branch, the dead-root `assertRootsResolvable` refusal, and the empty-corpus refusal.

### Tests

- `node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, carrying the new 11-case one-sided battery; production run → exit 0, `OK — 1091 pinned, 120 in the DEBT ledger, 3 exempt`.
- `node scripts/check-startup-registry-verdict.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `18 analysis case(s) + the dead-root hard error … + the one-sided ledger (8 case(s)) all passed`; production run → exit 0, `46 startup/open-registry seam(s) across 3585 file(s)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol.metadata-store-outage.test.ts` → exit 0, `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 32 passed (32)` (under the shared verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- No package test exercises either script. Eight `*.test.ts` files name one of them; all eight mention it in a comment only, and none asserts behaviour this PR changes.

<details><summary>Derived gate families — 66/69 exit 0, 3 NOT MEASURED (prerequisite), on 36c37411</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 69 families over the five changed paths; each ran with its exit captured before any pipe. 66 exited 0, including `pnpm check:engine-double-contract`, `pnpm check:startup-registry-verdict`, `pnpm check:durability-log-level`, `pnpm check:objectql-double-limit`, `pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `pnpm check:self-test-wired`, `pnpm check:entry-guard` and `pnpm check:doc-authoring`.

Three exited **3**, the prerequisite code, so they are NOT MEASURED rather than red — the same classification `--ran` derives from the recorded codes:

- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` — its positive-control fixture is pinned to a commit this shallow checkout cannot reach (`git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` is true).
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` — reads built output; 72 packages have no `dist/` in this container.
- `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` — its own self-test passed (22 cases); the gate then refused because `packages/objectql/dist/core.mjs` is absent.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE`, with each line recorded as `COMMAND :: exit CODE`, printed: `69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED (3 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`, 0 UNRUN.

The local-only families were not run: this diff touches neither `packages/spec`'s build nor a four-axis frame file. The repo-wide scans (`pnpm lint` first among them) and the whole farm are CI's run, and the `Lint & Repo Gates` check-run is the reading of record for both gates on this PR.

</details>

<details><summary>Changeset</summary>

`skip-changeset`. Root `scripts/*.mjs` and `scripts/*.json` ship in no package's `files[]`. The one `packages/**` path is a comment in a `*.test.ts`, and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` ships `["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]` — measured after the build: the comment's text (`pinned to each other`) has zero hits anywhere under `packages/metadata-protocol/dist`, with `listCommits` as the positive control hitting `dist/index.js`, `dist/index.cjs` and `dist/index.d.cts`.

</details>

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：#26549 漏下的两本棘轮台账(`engine-double-contract.baseline.json`、`startup-registry-verdict.baseline.json`)也改成单侧:数减少、文件被删、站点被修好 → 通过并在输出里报告;新增违例、计数变大 → 照旧变红。空扫描仍然变红:台账里列着、文件还在磁盘上、这次却没读到,就拒绝。另外改了一条过期注释(item 3)。
- 为什么改：删一个被台账列着的测试文件,或者修好一处被台账许可的站点,今天就会让一个根本没碰这个门禁的 PR 变红,而修法属于另一张卡。
- 风险与回滚：代价是「余量」——减少后没有手改台账,旧数仍是上限,可以悄悄补回同样多的违例;每条报告都写明了这个数。两个门禁都没有 `--update`,所以每条报告直接给出该手改哪一行。回滚就是 revert 本 PR,没有数据或接线变化。
- 先看：`scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs` 的 `reconcileDebtLedger()`(唯一带计数的一本,新增 `UNREAD` 拒绝),然后是 `scripts/check-startup-registry-verdict.mjs` 的 `reconcileLedger()` / `unreadBaselined()`。
- 两分钟验证：`git rm packages/cli/src/commands/serve-email-appname-precedence.test.ts && node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs; echo $?; git checkout HEAD -- packages/cli/src/commands/serve-email-appname-precedence.test.ts`,应看到 `DEBT ledger: 2 (file, verb) entr(ies) fell (passing, reported)`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的：item 4 的裁决(本 PR 不改行为):收窄后的检测器如果让活数下降,生产运行不再变红;对这两个门禁而言「磁盘上有、这次没读到就拒绝」这一臂能抓住哪些、抓不住哪些,写在下面的 Acceptance notes 里。item 2 在受管的 `lint.yml` 里,也留在卡上。席位落地本 PR。

## Acceptance notes

- **Headroom is the stated cost.** A one-sided ledger left above reality licenses that many sites until someone edits it by hand. Every decrease line names the number it leaves as the ceiling. The engine-double ledger's rows are keyed `(file, verb)`, so a stale row re-licenses that exact pair; if a file is later recreated at the same path it rides the stale count, and the report says to delete the entry.
- **Item 4, measured on these two gates.** The `UNREAD` arm catches a scan that lost part of its *corpus* — a walk that stopped descending, a root that moved, a file-kind filter that stopped matching — because it asks an identity (on disk, and not read) rather than a count. It does **not** catch a *recognizer* that narrowed: `check-engine-double-contract`'s discovery still reads every ledgered file, so a `scanSource` that stopped recognising a double's shape leaves the file read and its row a passing decrease. For that half the gate has two other guards it already had, both untouched here: `DISCOVERED` (a slice finding zero doubles anywhere) and the four population floors, of which `discoveredFiles ≥ 700` and `pinnedRows ≥ 600` are exactly the recognizer's own output — this run reads 1119 and 1000, so a narrowing that costs more than ~37% of discovery, or 40% of pins, refuses with exit 2 rather than reporting decreases. What stays uncovered is a narrowing smaller than that band which happens to land on ledgered files; for that, the self-test batteries driving the real recognizer over synthetic sources in both directions are the only instrument. `check-startup-registry-verdict` has no population floor and an empty ledger, so for it the whole detector-weakening axis rests on its self-test: the 18 analysis rows are what would red if a vocabulary entry or the AST walk stopped matching, and the empty-corpus and dead-root refusals cover only the total collapse. A floor there would be invented rather than measured (46 seams, 39 of them read-only), which is why this PR adds none.
- Not touched: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` and `scripts/engine-double-contract.seams.json` (GENERATED, opposite polarity — they record coverage and may only grow; open PR #26337 touches the pinned ledger), the durability vocabulary staleness checks, and `.github/workflows/lint.yml` (item 2, governed).
